blockers.reason: A human must judge whether timing, movement, recovery and hit feedback feel satisfying.
A machine can prove the window exists, not that six hits and four hearts create fair difficulty.
Boss readability and memorability remain aesthetic judgments.
Boss music and SFX integrity can be verified, but musical quality/mix require listening.
Adding a boss materially expands the adventure but does not prove $3.69 value.
Price worthiness remains a named human signoff.
Final storefront art approval remains separate.

authorityBoundary: v5.21 proves a playable timing-gated boss loop, boss reward, and progression binding. Difficulty, fairness, readability, fun, memorability, musical quality, and commercial value remain human judgments.
